expected_structural_delta: No new production modules, roots, state owners, protocols, or public operations. Add explicit failure propagation at one existing validation owner and extend one test file.
minimum_design: Make the existing ensure_dirs and registry_login calls hard gates in github_validate. Reuse the current ownership test harness to prove that Docker is not reached.
outcome: When GitHub validation cannot create required directories or cannot log in to a configured registry, validation returns failure before Docker validation starts.

reuse_decisions.name: github_validate prerequisite calls
reuse_decisions.rationale: The existing GitHub validation sequence already calls both prerequisites. Propagating their return status closes the false-success boundary without changing ownership.

reuse_decisions.name: tests/ownership-safety.sh
reuse_decisions.rationale: The existing ownership harness already stubs the provider path and can prove both prerequisite failures stop Docker.
